title: Federal Highways Administration (FHWA) / Cool Pavement and Shade Structures Project / Grant Funds
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services be INSTRUCTED to accept the award of $2,500,000 in Federal Highways Administration (FHWA) grant funds for the Cool Pavement and Shade Structures project and to submit grant reimbursement requests to the grantor and receive the grant funds. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services be INSTRUCTED to expeditiously submit reimbursement requests and that all grant reimbursements should be deposited to the Subventions & Grants Fund, Fund 305, Department 50, Account TBD. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services, in coordination with the City Administrative Officer, be AUTHORIZED to transfer funding between Bureau of Street Services accounts in order to implement the grant requirements. I FURTHER MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services, in coordination with the City Administrative Officer and Department of Transportation, be INSTRUCTED to report back through the annual Transportation Grand Fund report, or other reports as necessary, on the needs for additional front funding to cover project expenses. I FURTHER MOVE to AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services, or designee, to make any necessary technical and/or accounting adjustments to the recommendations above to effectuate the intent of the City Council action. PRESENTED BY SECONDED BY: IMELDA PADILLA (/ LSG Councilmember, 6th District SEP 1 1 2026
